description:
Knox Rainerio once cruelly pushed away Halid Via, the boy who loved him, to protect him. But now, the grown Halid stands beside the Second Prince, holding the head of the Crown Prince who became a traitor. The Second Prince—now Emperor—then gifts ‘Knox Rainerio’ to Halid as a reward. “From now on, this is your duty.” Halid removes his robe and straddles Knox, who is now his slave. Halid’s body is covered in scars and looks muscular. Knox tries to escape, but Halid holds him down firmly. “No, this isn’t right…” Halid pulls Knox’s hair and whispers, “I brought you here for this.”
